sentences.en: CLERK: Conference Centre Reservations
Good morning
WOMAN: Hi
I'm interested in the computing conference next month
sentences.zh: 我对下个月的计算机会议很感兴趣。

sentences.en: CLERK: Future Directions in Computing?
Example
WOMAN: Yes, that's right
Could I ask you a few questions about it?
sentences.zh: 我可以就这次会议向您提几个问题吗？

sentences.en: CLERK: Of course
WOMAN: OK
I know the conference is for three days but actually I want to attend on the Friday and Saturday only
sentences.zh: 我知道会议为期三天，但我实际上只想参加周五和周六两天。

sentences.en: Will that work out to be any cheaper?
CLERK: Let me have a look
Well, you could register for the two days separately, but that wouldn't actually save you very much as it still costs £35 for each day
sentences.zh: 嗯，您可以分别注册这两天，但其实并不会节省太多费用，因为每天仍需支付35英镑。

sentences.en: In fact, if you could register for the three days, you also get an invitation to a frec dinner on the Saturday night, so that's probably the better option
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果您注册全部三天，您还将获邀参加周六晚上的免费晚宴，所以这可能是更好的选择。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right, I'll do that
How much will the fees be in that case?
WOMAN: All right
I'd like to register for the full three days
Now, can I pay that by credit card?
sentences.zh: 那么，我可以用信用卡付款吗？

sentences.en: CLERK: I'm afraid not
You'll have to send a cheque to us, or you can pay at the conference office
sentences.zh: 您需要给我们寄一张支票，或者也可以在会议办公室现场付款。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Fine
So it's probably easiest if I pay by cheque
sentences.zh: 那我用支票付款可能最方便。

sentences.en: Now then, what else do need to arrange?
sentences.zh: 接下来，我还需安排些什么？

sentences.en: Right
How about accommodation?
I guess that's not included in the price?
sentences.zh: 我想这应该不包含在费用里吧？

sentences.en: CLERK: No, I'm sorry, it's not, but we do have a few rooms available for delegates at the conference centre if you'd like
sentences.zh: CLERK: 是的，很抱歉，并不包含。不过，如果您有兴趣，我们会议中心确实为参会代表预留了几间客房。

sentences.en: Those are very cheap but if you're interested you'll need to book soon, because there's always a heavy demand for them
sentences.zh: 这些房间价格非常便宜，但如果您有意入住，就得尽快预订，因为这类房间需求一直很高。

sentences.en: They are only £15 per night, but they are very 03 basic and you'd have to get your own breakfast, because they don't provide you with that
sentences.zh: 每晚仅15英镑，但条件相当基础，而且您需自行解决早餐，因为酒店不提供早餐。

sentences.en: But it's very convenient, because it's in the same building as the conference rooms
sentences.zh: 不过非常便利，因为就在会议厅所在的同一栋楼内。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Uhuh
CLERK: Or there's a very reasonable guest house which is £25 per night
sentences.zh: CLERK: 或者还有一家价格合理的寄宿公寓，每晚25英镑。

sentences.en: And I 04 think that includes your breakfast
WOMAN: Is it close to the conference centre?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 它离会议中心近吗？

sentences.en: CLERK: It would be about a ten-minute walk away from here
sentences.zh: CLERK: 从这里步行过去大约十分钟。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I see
That sounds quite reasonable
CLERK: The details arc all in our conference pack, which I'll send you
sentences.zh: CLERK: 详细信息都在我们的会议资料包中，我将寄给您。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Great, thanks
That'll be very useful
Oh, and can you also send me an application form?
sentences.zh: 哦，您还能顺便给我寄一份申请表吗？

sentences.en: CLERK: Of course
I'll get that in the post to you straight away
sentences.zh: 我马上把申请表通过邮局寄给您。

sentences.en: Is there anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有其他需要帮忙的吗？

sentences.en: SA
WOMAN: Yes, actually
Can you tell me where exactly the conference centre is?
sentences.zh: 您能告诉我会议中心的确切位置吗？

sentences.en: CLERK: Well, it's on South Park Road and it's right at the end of the road © next to the library
sentences.zh: CLERK: 好的，它位于南公园路，就在该条路的尽头 © ，紧邻图书馆。

sentences.en: It's a ten-minute taxi ride from the station and will cost you £5
sentences.zh: 从火车站打车到那里只需十分钟，费用为5英镑。

sentences.en: Otherwise, you can take the bus which runs every half an 09 hour from the station - that's the 21A - and it brings you straight to the conference centre
sentences.zh: 否则，您也可以乘坐公交车，该线路每半小时一班，从火车站发车——即21A路——可直达会议中心。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right, got that
